data.title: Pflegeversicherung: Pflegegrad 2 granted (Pflegegrad 3 denied)
data.summary: The Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse informs Tarek Beispiel that, based on the Medizinischer Dienst assessment of 12 March 2025, he is assessed at care level (Pflegegrad) 2 as of 1 February 2025, not the requested Pflegegrad 3. He will receive a monthly Pflegegeld (care allowance) of €347.00 as long as he arranges his own care.
data.explanation: This letter grants you Pflegegrad 2 and a monthly cash benefit of €347.00, but not the higher Pflegegrad 3 you had applied for. If you think the assessment (only 38.75 weighted points) should have led to Pflegegrad 3, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Pflegekasse, in writing or in person; the app shows the deadline. If you take no action, the decision becomes final and only the Pflegegrad 2 benefit applies. The €347.00 will be paid automatically to your account at the end of each month, so no separate claim is needed for that.

items.action: If you believe Pflegegrad 3 should have been granted, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Pflegekasse, or have it recorded in person there.
